name: Europa
about: Europa as a small disc in front of or behind the backdrop planet (a mission's backdrop.moons).
mapWhy: USGS Astrogeology, Europa Voyager / Galileo SSI global mosaic 500 m (access and use constraints 'none': a U.S. Government work), the 1024 x 512 image, black and white, warmed very slightly and its polar gap filled by tools/jupiter/build_moons.py; docs/licences/planets.md
albedoScaleWhy: ours: the mosaic is contrast-stretched (linear mean 0.31); Europa's geometric albedo is about 0.67, the brightest in the system, so the scale brings the mean to 0.59

moon.why: Europa's orbit radius and period (NASA planetary satellite fact sheet): 671,100 km, 3.551 days
